What this means:

内容:
C10 的实际收益率分项触发：10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-31 达到 2.47pp，较过去 90 日低点 1.89pp 上升 0.58pp，触及 2 倍阈值，升级为 HIGH。

Why it matters:
A sharp real-yield spike tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows, directly pressuring the valuations that assume years of payoff before hardware depreciates out. It's a liquidity-side stress tell independent of any single company's fundamentals.

影响:
实际收益率急升会收紧金融条件，抬高对长久期 AI capex 现金流所用的贴现率，直接压制那些依赖多年后才能回本的估值假设。这是独立于单一公司基本面的流动性端压力信号。

Treat as a watch item, not a signal. 影响: 这属于邻近噪音，不是确认的解禁触发——报道把 SPCX 和泛泛的宏观日历事件放在一起提及，并不能验证 S-1 推算日历中的某个具体批次本周确实解禁。应当当作观察项，而不是信号。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] DRAM Price Surge Hits Costs Like a "Once-in-a-Century Flood": Apple Warns, Nomura Sees DRAM Revenue Topping $2 Trillion
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:36:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5pWUs5QUhpOXlJbUJvMlZFZkNySWc4RGZpakVqM2xSUzdZRGtoTWtkc1RiSmtsV3ZpdlJfbThldS11SkIxdVFHa1RGZkpVZ2VJeXYxM0VvNG91UGg5ZjBFZFFCWXJkNUNPVVNIVGpud0g4dlRYTUE?oc=5 DRAM Price Surge Hits Costs Like a "Once-in-a-Century Flood": Apple Warns, Nomura Sees DRAM Revenue Topping $2 Trillion - finance.biggo.com DRAM Price Surge Hits Costs Like a "Once-in-a-Century Flood": Apple Warns, Nomura Sees DRAM Revenue Topping $2 Trillion  finance.biggo.com ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A Google News RSS item reports DRAM price surges hitting costs like a "once-in-a-century flood," with Apple warning on the impact and Nomura projecting DRAM revenue could top $2 trillion. 内容: 一条 Google News RSS 报道称，DRAM 价格暴涨对成本的冲击如「百年一遇的洪水」，Apple 对此发出警告，野村证券预测 DRAM 收入将突破 2 万亿美元。 Why it matters: Memory pricing pressure squeezes hardware margins across the AI supply chain — HBM/DRAM scarcity raises the effective cost of every AI server built, and a forecast this extreme (a 12x-plus jump toward $2T) signals either genuine capacity strain or speculative overshoot feeding the bubble narrative from the supplier side. 影响: 内存价格压力会挤压整个 AI 供应链的硬件利润——HBM/DRAM 短缺推高了每台 AI 服务器的实际成本，而这样极端的预测（跃升逾 12 倍达到 2 万亿美元）既可能反映真实的产能紧张，也可能是从供应端助推泡沫叙事的投机性预期。

alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

Move:     +52bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.41pp on 2026-07-30, up 0.52pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89pp.

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-30升至2.41pp，较过去90个交易日低点1.89pp上升了0.52pp。

Why it matters:
A rising real yield tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows, directly pressuring the valuations that justify current hyperscaler spend. This crosses C10's real-yield trigger, adding a second liquidity-fuse alongside the broad-dollar index.

影响:
实际收益率上行会收紧金融条件，并抬高对AI capex这类长久期现金流的贴现率，直接压制支撑当前超大规模厂商支出叙事的估值逻辑。此次触发了C10的实际收益率阈值，与广义美元指数一起构成流动性双重警报。
